topic: Joyce judgment and Hoover’s testimony / destruction of minutes
claim_as_settled: Chang Yen-Mao v. Moreing (and Bewick, Moreing, and the new CEMC) opened before Mr. Justice Joyce in Chancery on January 17, 1905, and ran sixteen days. Hoover was not a named defendant (the suit was filed May 7, 1903). claim_as_settled: It began Monday, June 24, 1867: E. B. claim_as_settled: In 1883, after Democrats took the governorship and the legislature, Governor George Stoneman withdrew the unconfirmed recess nomination of Leland Stanford (appointed by Republican Governor George C. Leland Jr. died March 13, 1884; the Founding Grant is November 11, 1885. Do not treat spite as the documented founding motive.

topic: Ross affair: 1900 chronology and the 1901 Committee of Economists report
claim_as_settled: The 1901 Report of the Committee of Economists (appointed Detroit, December 28, 1900) establishes: Ross missed the usual early-May 1900 reappointment, was reappointed June 2, and on June 5 submitted a resignation effective the end of 1900–01 after learning “Mrs. Stanford does not approve of me as an economist, and does not want me to remain here.” Jordan accepted it on November 12, still praising Ross.
